title: Not Absorbent
text: Not Absorbent. i loved the design; however, these ceramic stone coasters were not absorbent at all. Water pooled up on top of the coasters which defeats the purpose.

product_metadata.title: Absorbent Coaster For Drinks - 8 Pack Large 4.3" Size Ceramic Thirsty Stone With Cork Back To Fit Bigger Cup, 2 COASTERS For Each Design No Holder - 4 Pretty Mandala Patterns Make A Stylish Home Decor
features: SUPERB ABSORBING TO KEEP YOUR TABLE DRY - Made from Thirsty Ceramic Stone which absorbs moisture BETTER than Sandstone. STAY PUT & NON STICK to your glass even when the coaster surface is wet thanks to its heavy weight. NOVELTY SET BUILT TO LAST WITH STRONG MATERIAL & VIBRANT COLOR - Easily handles bumps and drops, and will NEVER FADE or scratch off.

UNLIKE OTHERS ONLY MEASURED 4" (10 cm), WE MAKE OURS SLIGHTLY OVER-SIZE & THICK ON PURPOSE - 4.3 INCHES ( 11 cm ) in diameter provides a large and solid support that fits all types of glasses: hiball, lowball, highball, bourbon whisky, scotch glass. Compared to paper or cork coasters, these absorbant coastrs NEVER stick to the bottom of your bottles or glasses then fall back onto you when you pick up your drink

ANTI SCRATCH CORK BACK PAD - Not only the backing material creates a friendly layer to your wooden surface, protecting any delicate countertop like Walnut, Granite, Bamboo, Oak, Marble, Pine wood from scuff & spill, it also produces enough gripping power to prevent the coaster from slipping or being blown away, which means your coaster will stay put even being used outdoor in a windy day!

SURPRISINGLY BEAUTIFUL WITH CRYSTAL CLEAR DETAILS - No more boring or eye-soring coasters. Our AMAZING artwork is PERMANENTLY printed onto the coaster using UV ink technology. Use these as momentos for a ladies’ Lenten retreat, or conversation starter for party, entertaining gala as well as present for wedding registry. Each piece features attractive vintage ethnic floral patterns.

DON’T BUY ANY COASTER SET BEFORE READING THIS--> Other coasters made of cork, paper, cardboard, rubber, ceramic, slate tile, agate and fabric rug cloth do not have the same absorbent power as this ceramic stone coasters. Non absorbent coasters may cause condensation sticking to the bottom of your bottles or glasses then fall back onto you when you pick up your drink!
Bohemian Boho Vibe added to your home decor
